files..claude-plugin/plugin.json:
{
  "name": "pixel-pets",
  "version": "0.4.0",
  "description": "Pixel-art pets above the prompt that react to what Claude and each subagent are doing",
  "author": {
    "name": "Henrique Schroeder"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/HenriqueSchroeder/pixel-pets",
  "license": "MIT",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "pet": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pet",
      "description": "Which pet to show. Pick custom to use your own pack, named in Custom pet",
      "default": "cat",
      "options": [
        "cat",
        "slime",
        "dog",
        "ghost",
        "owl",
        "clawd",
        "fox",
        "dragon",
        "capybara",
        "custom"
      ]
    },
    "customPet": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Custom pet",
      "description": "Your own pack when Pet is custom: the name of a file in ~/.claude/pets/, without .json",
      "default": ""
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "Language of the pet's labels. auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then $LANG",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "en",
        "pt-BR"
      ]
    },
    "awakeMinutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Awake minutes",
      "description": "How long the pet stays awake, strolling around, after Claude finishes, before it falls asleep",
      "default": 1
    }
  }
}
